mission: Recover formal-1 eligibility for the 900e949 five-role DSP candidate after two host-side orchestration defects in the first formal attempt: the in-run foreground monitor exceeded the 2 s cadence contract, and the post-exit evidence transfer aborted on a single 180 s ADB wrapper bound. Repair only host orchestration. Do not change arithmetic, candidate, graph, fixture, observer, or Backend/Device lifetime. Qualification evidence must remain separate per claim.

monitor.root_cause: v1 ran a blocking $process.WaitForExit(2000) in series with a serial competition/awake/top query block, so the observed start-to-start interval was the sum of the wait plus the query latencies, not a 2 s period.
monitor.reconciliation: 4.029617 s median = 2.379454 s post-top-to-ps-completion including the 2000 ms wait + 0.99 s awake + 0.36 s top; iterations that also ran the 10 s thermal block reached 5.244854 s.

frozen_candidate_identity.apk: approved existing build/reports/g1-s2-mixed-qkv-df-hvx-v/approved-apk/app-debug.apk; no install, no replacement, no rebuild
frozen_candidate_identity.reason_frozen: Any candidate or arithmetic change would invalidate the 58,944-pair numerical pilot; this mission repairs only host observation and transfer.

changed: new v3 formal-1 runner that composes those modules (scripts/run_backward_shared_lifetime_formal_v3.ps1)

v3_formal1.scope: Stage=formal-1 only; pilot, formal-2, formal-3 and performance remain bound to their frozen runners

monitor_contract.schedule: deadline_k = previous_sample_start_k + Period - Lead, evaluated on a fixed monotonic deadline sequence; no deadline is re-based on a late completion, so lateness never accumulates into a shorter next interval.
monitor_contract.timing_source: single monotonic clock object per monitor; start measured immediately before the first command of the serial fast lane
monitor_contract.overlap: none; a sample never starts before the previous sample's lane and auxiliary claim handling complete

auxiliary_lane.rule: the auxiliary thermal read never blocks the 2 s fast lane; an unfinished claim is collected at a later deadline without delaying the next sample start

violation_semantics: a missed absolute deadline is recorded as an explicit violation, never silently absorbed
command timeouts, invalid samples and unknown states each have their own counter
contract_met is false if any counter is non-zero, if any start-to-start interval exceeds 2000 ms, or if any sample is invalid
in the device runner a timing violation preserves readback and identity first, sets safety_complete=false, and then throws MONITOR_CONTRACT_VIOLATION; it does not stop the probe for lateness
monitor_contract.state_violations: asleep, foreground takeover, competing NPU workload, unknown states and auxiliary failures still stop the owned probe through the existing Stop-Owned path
monitor_contract.post_exit_separation: post-exit checks use a fresh monitor so they cannot contaminate the in-run cadence ledger

transport_contract.method: binary-safe adb exec-out dd per fixed byte range
transport_contract.resume: completed chunk part files are hashed and reused; no restart from zero after a chunk failure
transport_contract.partial_preservation: on failure the partial file and its per-chunk parts remain on disk; nothing is deleted or overwritten
identity_contract: all three equal per role file
transport_contract.gzip_retention: the gzip readback is retained because certify_v2 requires both the raw file and its .gz
transport_contract.remote_policy: remote originals are read-only and are never deleted, overwritten or re-uploaded
transport_contract.no_safety_relaxation: the transfer runs after the owned probe exits; it never pauses, replaces or relaxes the in-run 2 s monitor

monitor_test.pass_line: backward_formal_monitor_host=PASS cases=16 selftest_cases=14 realistic_period=2000 max_start_to_start_ms=1958.36 device_calls=0

dry_run.emulation_basis: attribution medians: competition 379 ms, awake 994 ms, top 361 ms; disclosed as emulation, not device measurement

assessor.mode: --entry formal-1 (read-only, no device calls) and --out for the private assessment

device_entry_gate.observed_reason: no online ADB endpoint; the configured wireless endpoint is absent from the ADB device table and its TCP port is unreachable
device_entry_gate.reentry_condition: restore a valid online wireless-debug ADB endpoint on the same physical device, then re-run the monitor dry-run gate, the host tests and the entry assessor before any formal process

entry_conditions: monitor host test qualified (16/16, pass line last, one module hash, max <= 2000 ms, device_calls=0)
transport host test qualified (16/16, binary roundtrip PASS, pass line last, one module hash, device_calls=0)
host-only monitor dry run contract met with zero missed deadlines/timeouts/invalid/unknown and max <= 2000 ms
58,944-pair pilot numerics independently verified against the frozen five legacy anchors
device entry gate PASS with an online same-physical-device endpoint
no prior formal-1 attempt directory for this repaired runner
v3 runner sha256 matches the committed plan record
new plan sha256 matches the committed plan file
